events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Foot Too Far
events.text: Finally reaching [city], [character] spends a week there visiting the holy sites. Upon returning, he confides that by the end he was just excited for the journey to be over and found it difficult to feel any connection to. If you make the journey yourself, [character] advises, take a horse.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Pilgrims Attacked

options.text: There is no question, [character] leaps to action!
Faith guides his blade to defend the pilgrims.

events.text: [character] pilgrimage to [city] takes him on roads through many different lands. Not all are happy about the presence of [religion] travelers. The group that [character] is traveling with are suddenly ambushed by bandits, circling around the mostly unarmed pilgrims. [character] is frozen, deciding whether to fight, and starts to imagine what you would advise...

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Stories on the Road
events.text: On the road to [city] [character] falls in with a group of [rival] merchants. The unlikely party sing songs and share stories to while away the days on the road. Eventually their paths lead separate ways, but [character] is pleased to have had such an amusing, if rather impious, diversion.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Blessed Pilgrim
events.text: Finally reaching [city], [character] spends a week there visiting the holy sites and keeping in solemn reflection. Returning to [rival], [character] is a changed man and claims to be imbued with divine grace.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Holy Hand(s)
events.text: [character] stops at a city on the road to [city], pleased to find that the inn where he is staying is a common haven for people treading the same pilgrim path. [character] is enjoying drinks with the other pilgrims that night, until the realization that he and three others have all been sold the same 'Holy Hand', supposedly owned by the founder of [religion]. The relic used the last of [character] money and the dejected pilgrim reluctantly sends a message asking for more.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Holy Path
events.text: Following the path to [city] has given [character] plenty of time to reflect on the nature of the divine. Days are spent walking, every step a dedication to. The nights are for resting and dreaming of the holy city.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Pilgrimage's End

options.text: Congratulate him on seeing the journey through.

events.text: Finally reaching [city], [character] spends a week there visiting the holy sites and meeting the of the city. As well as endearing himself and your court to the elders of the religion, [character] returns to [rival] satisfied with his journey of faith.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Right Way of Worship

options.text: Send a message reassuring [character] that he will be heard.

events.text: [character] journey to [city] is progressing well, but his mind is fixated on what will happen once there. The other pilgrims describe a complex ritual of sayings and rites that must be performed to be heard by. Each one has a different set of instructions based on what they have heard works, and [character] is soon swimming in amulets and incantations.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Welcoming
events.text: On the road to [city], [character] is battered by the wind and rain until he is barely able to stand. A kind takes in the pilgrim, offering [character] a place to rest until he has recovered from the fever that has taken hold. Although not his intended destination, over the weeks [character] becomes firm friends with the and spends many nights in lively discussion.
